changeSet.author: kate
changeSet.sql: -- The connecting user may switch to the app role GRANT dewtally_app TO CURRENT_USER; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO dewtally_app; GRANT SELECT, INSERT , UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO dewtally_app; -- Liquibase bookkeeping is none of the application's business REVOKE ALL ON databasechangelog, databasechangeloglock FROM dewtally_app; -- Tables created by later migrations get the same rights automatically ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT, INSERT , UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO dewtally_app;

changeSet.author: kate
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION current_tenant_id() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$ SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') ::uuid $$;

changeSet.author: kate
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION document_tenant(uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ SELECT tenant_id FROM invoice_document WHERE id = $1 $$;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION document_tenant(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION document_tenant (uuid) TO dewtally_app;
